# What this script does

The Results text cited about 33 output CSVs. This script gathers them into **seven
supplementary tables** (Tables S3–S9) and one data file (Data S1), so the text can cite
a table number instead of a CSV name. It does **no new statistics**. Every value is read
from a table that an earlier script wrote. Only these operations happen here:

* **rename** columns to manuscript wording
* **join** tables that describe the same thing (one KEGG category, one lineage, one feature)
* **stack** tables that share a layout, with a column naming the source
* **sum** pair-level TPM into lineage-level expression shares (Table S6)

Each table keeps a `source_table` column (or a note in its sheet), so any number in the
manuscript can be traced back to the script that made it.

| Table | Contents | Built from (script: output table) |
|---|---|---|
| S3 | Taxonomic rank choice and composition | 02: `02_grain_curve`, `02_resolution_by_depth`; 03: `03_taxa_vent_vs_nonvent_group`, `03_taxa_vent_vs_nonvent_L4` |
| S4 | Community-level statistics, one row per test | 04: `04_env_effects`, `04_delta_r2`, `04_procrustes_habitat_check`, `04_q1_pcoa_envfit`, `04_q1_dbrda_summary`, `04_q1_dbrda_per_variable`, `04_q1_imputation_sensitivity` |
| S5 | KEGG level-B categories | 05: `05_composition_kegg`, `05_kegg_by_habitat`, `05_class_kegg_enrichment` |
| S6 | Lineages (class level) | 05b: `05b_lineage_repertoire`, `05b_taxon_ko_habitat`, `05b_carrier_summary`; 05: `05_composition_taxon` |
| S7 | Robustness of the vent-only result | 08: `08_lineage_headline_sweep`, `08_field_drop_lineage`, `08_depth_matched_depths` |
| S8 | Trophic-mode panel, one row per feature | 06: `06_panel_habitat`, `06_panel_feature_taxon_breadth`; 07: `07_panel_ko_delta` |
| S9 | Trophic-mode panel by lineage | 06: `06_panel_taxon_mode_summary`, `06_panel_taxon_presence`, `06_panel_unit_summary` |
| Data S1 | Every habitat-associated lineage-resolved KO | 05b: `05b_taxon_ko_habitat` |

Outputs:

* `output-tables/supplementary/Supplementary_Tables_S3-S9.xlsx`, with one sheet per table part
  (S3a, S3b, …) and a `README` sheet
* the same sheets as individual CSVs in `output-tables/supplementary/`, for anyone without Excel
* `output-tables/supplementary/Data_S1_lineage_resolved_KOs.csv`

**Run order.** Render after 02–08 are current:
`quarto render scripts/10-supplementary-tables.qmd` from the repo root.

# Set up

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# locator: root (render) or scripts/ (interactive)
source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R")

# writexl writes .xlsx with no Java or system dependencies. It is not yet used elsewhere
# in the repo: install once with install.packages("writexl").
stopifnot("writexl is needed: install.packages('writexl')" = requireNamespace("writexl", quietly = TRUE))
```

```{r paths}
IN_DIR  <- "output-tables"
OUT_DIR <- file.path(IN_DIR, "supplementary")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# read_out(): read one output table by its base name. If a table is missing, it fails and
# names the script that writes it, so a stale or missing upstream render is obvious.
read_out <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(IN_DIR, paste0(name, if (str_detect(name, "\\.csv")) "" else ".csv"))
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop(glue("{path} not found: re-render script {str_extract(name, '^[0-9]+b?')} first"))
  }
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
}
```

The date each input table was written. Check it before you submit: every table should
come from the same round of renders.

```{r input-dates}
inputs <- c("02_grain_curve", "02_resolution_by_depth",
            "03_taxa_vent_vs_nonvent_group", "03_taxa_vent_vs_nonvent_L4",
            "04_env_effects", "04_delta_r2", "04_procrustes_habitat_check", "04_q1_pcoa_envfit",
            "04_q1_dbrda_summary", "04_q1_dbrda_per_variable", "04_q1_imputation_sensitivity",
            "05_composition_kegg", "05_kegg_by_habitat", "05_class_kegg_enrichment",
            "05_composition_taxon",
            "05b_lineage_repertoire", "05b_taxon_ko_habitat", "05b_carrier_summary",
            "06_panel_habitat", "06_panel_feature_taxon_breadth", "06_panel_taxon_mode_summary",
            "06_panel_taxon_presence", "06_panel_unit_summary",
            "07_panel_ko_delta",
            "08_lineage_headline_sweep", "08_field_drop_lineage", "08_depth_matched_depths")
input_dates <- tibble(table = inputs,
                      written = as.Date(file.mtime(file.path(IN_DIR, paste0(inputs, ".csv")))))
input_dates
```

# Table S3: taxonomic rank choice and composition (scripts 02, 03)

**S3a.** For each taxonomic rank ("grain"), the share of scaledTPM resolved to that rank,
and how much taxonomic variation habitat and vent field explain (PERMANOVA). Results B
cites these values for choosing rank 4. `matrix` is `taxonomy` (all taxa) or
`taxonomy_prev` (after the ≥ 4-sample prevalence filter).

```{r s3a}
s3a <- read_out("02_grain_curve") |>
  filter(matrix %in% c("taxonomy", "taxonomy_prev")) |>
  left_join(read_out("02_resolution_by_depth") |> select(grain, resolved_frac_tpm),
            by = "grain") |>
  transmute(rank = grain,
            matrix = recode(matrix, taxonomy = "All taxa",
                            taxonomy_prev = "Prevalence filtered (>= 4 samples)"),
            factor = recode(term, vent_bin = "Habitat (vent vs. non-vent)", field = "Vent field"),
            n_taxa = n_features,
            permanova_R2 = R2, permanova_p = p, permdisp_p = dispersion_p,
            resolved_share_tpm = resolved_frac_tpm,
            source_table = "02_grain_curve; 02_resolution_by_depth") |>
  arrange(matrix, factor, rank)
s3a
```

**S3b.** Mean (SD) share of scaledTPM per sample in vent and non-vent samples. The rows
are supergroups, with dinoflagellates, ciliates and Syndiniales listed as separate groups
(`level = "Group"`), and then class-level lineages (`level = "Class (rank 4)"`).
Results B and Figure 1 use these values.

```{r s3b}
s3b <- bind_rows(
  read_out("03_taxa_vent_vs_nonvent_group") |>
    mutate(level = "Group", lineage = cur_group, source_table = "03_taxa_vent_vs_nonvent_group"),
  read_out("03_taxa_vent_vs_nonvent_L4") |>
    mutate(level = "Class (rank 4)", lineage = taxon_L4, source_table = "03_taxa_vent_vs_nonvent_L4")
) |>
  transmute(level, group = cur_group, lineage,
            vent_mean_pct, vent_sd_pct, nonvent_mean_pct, nonvent_sd_pct, source_table) |>
  arrange(level, desc(vent_mean_pct))
s3b
```

# Table S4: community-level statistics (script 04)

This is one long table with one row per test, so every statistic in Results C has a
single place to cite. Every test reads into the same columns:

* `test`: which analysis (PERMANOVA, PERMDISP, ΔR², Procrustes, envfit, dbRDA)
* `matrix`: taxonomy or function
* `factor`: the factor or environmental variable tested
* `subset`: the samples used (all 19, or the 13 vent samples), plus any conditioning
* `statistic`, `value`, `p`

```{r s4}
# PERMANOVA (R2, p) and PERMDISP (p) share one source row, so they are split into two rows
env <- read_out("04_env_effects")
s4_permanova <- bind_rows(
  env |> transmute(test = "PERMANOVA", matrix, factor = contrast, subset = "All samples",
                   statistic = "R2", value = R2, p, n = n_units),
  env |> transmute(test = "PERMDISP", matrix, factor = contrast, subset = "All samples",
                   statistic = "dispersion test", value = NA_real_, p = dispersion_p, n = n_units)
) |> mutate(source_table = "04_env_effects")

# Delta R2 = R2(taxonomy) - R2(function); jackknife 95% CI. A CI that spans 0 = not different.
s4_delta <- read_out("04_delta_r2") |>
  transmute(test = "Delta R2 (taxonomy - function)", matrix = "both",
            factor = recode(term, vent_bin = "Habitat (vent vs. non-vent)", field = "Vent field"),
            subset = glue("All samples; 95% jackknife CI {round(ci_low, 3)} to {round(ci_high, 3)}"),
            statistic = "Delta R2", value = delta_observed, p = NA_real_, n = 19,
            source_table = "04_delta_r2")

# Procrustes: taxonomic vs. functional PCoA, on 2-4 axes, for all samples, vents only,
# and with habitat means removed
s4_procrustes <- read_out("04_procrustes_habitat_check") |>
  transmute(test = "Procrustes", matrix = "taxonomy vs. function",
            factor = glue("{k_axes} PCoA axes"), subset = test,
            statistic = "r", value = procrustes_r, p, n = n_units,
            source_table = "04_procrustes_habitat_check")

# envfit: environmental vectors on the first two PCoA axes (vent samples).
# p_free = unrestricted permutations; p_within_field = permutations within vent field
s4_envfit <- read_out("04_q1_pcoa_envfit") |>
  pivot_longer(c(p_free, p_within_field), names_to = "perm", values_to = "p") |>
  transmute(test = "envfit", matrix = recode(level, ko = "function"), factor = variable,
            subset = if_else(perm == "p_free", "Vent samples",
                             "Vent samples; permutations within vent field"),
            statistic = "r2", value = r2, p, n = 13, source_table = "04_q1_pcoa_envfit")

# dbRDA, full model after VIF screening (CH4 removed as collinear) and forward selection
s4_dbrda <- read_out("04_q1_dbrda_summary") |>
  transmute(test = "dbRDA (full model)", matrix = recode(level, ko = "function"),
            factor = glue("TEMP + pH + Mg; selected: {selected}"), subset = "Vent samples",
            statistic = "adj. R2", value = full_adjR2, p = global_p, n = 13,
            source_table = "04_q1_dbrda_summary")

# dbRDA, one variable at a time: alone, and conditioned on vent field
s4_dbrda_var <- read_out("04_q1_dbrda_per_variable") |>
  pivot_longer(-c(level, variable), names_to = c(".value", "model"),
               names_pattern = "(adjR2|p)_(alone|given_field)") |>
  transmute(test = "dbRDA (single variable)", matrix = recode(level, ko = "function"),
            factor = variable,
            subset = if_else(model == "alone", "Vent samples", "Vent samples; conditioned on vent field"),
            statistic = "adj. R2", value = adjR2, p, n = 13,
            source_table = "04_q1_dbrda_per_variable")

# Imputation check: single-variable dbRDA without the one sample (SirVentsAlot) whose pH
# and CH4 were filled with the Gorda Ridge vent mean
s4_impute <- read_out("04_q1_imputation_sensitivity") |>
  transmute(test = "dbRDA (single variable)", matrix = recode(level, ko = "function"),
            factor = variable, subset = "Vent samples, imputed sample removed",
            statistic = "adj. R2", value = adjR2_alone_no_imputed, p = p_alone_no_imputed,
            n = n_units, source_table = "04_q1_imputation_sensitivity")

s4 <- bind_rows(s4_permanova, s4_delta, s4_procrustes, s4_envfit,
                s4_dbrda, s4_dbrda_var, s4_impute) |>
  mutate(across(c(factor, subset), as.character))
s4
```

# Table S5: KEGG level-B categories (script 05)

One row per KEGG level-B category. The Figure 3 numbers in Results D come from here:

* **Cliff's δ** (vent vs. non-vent, 78 sample pairs) and its permutation tier.
  `delta_tier` marks *, ** or *** for above the 50th, 75th or 95th percentile of the
  permuted largest |δ|; only *** counts as significant.
* **Mean share** of expression in vent and non-vent samples.
* **Fisher enrichment** of each KO habitat class (vent-associated, shared, non-vent-associated)
  in the category: observed KOs `k_*`, expected `exp_*` and BH-adjusted `q_*`.

```{r s5}
enrich_wide <- read_out("05_class_kegg_enrichment") |>
  mutate(class = recode(class_group, "Vent-associated" = "vent", "Shared" = "shared",
                        "Non-vent-associated" = "nonvent")) |>
  select(description, class, k, expected, q_bh) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = class, values_from = c(k, expected, q_bh),
              names_glue = "{.value}_{class}") |>
  rename_with(\(x) str_replace(x, "^expected_", "exp_"), starts_with("expected_")) |>
  rename_with(\(x) str_replace(x, "^q_bh_", "q_"), starts_with("q_bh_"))

s5 <- read_out("05_composition_kegg") |>
  left_join(read_out("05_kegg_by_habitat"), by = "description") |>
  left_join(enrich_wide, by = "description") |>
  transmute(kegg_level_A = a_description, kegg_level_B = description,
            cliffs_delta, delta_tier = replace_na(delta_stars, ""),
            significant, perm95_threshold,
            mean_share_vent = `mean_share_Vent`, mean_share_nonvent = `mean_share_Non-vent`,
            pick(starts_with("k_"), starts_with("exp_"), starts_with("q_"))) |>
  arrange(desc(cliffs_delta))
s5
```

Figure 3B uses the KO class totals. They are a footnote to S5, not a separate table.

```{r s5-footnote}
s5_ko_classes <- read_out("05_ko_habitat_class") |> count(habitat_class, name = "n_KOs")
s5_ko_classes
```

# Table S6: lineages (scripts 05b, 05)

**S6a.** One row per class-level lineage that has at least one habitat-associated
lineage-resolved KO. Results E and Figure 4 come from here:

* counts of the lineage's KOs in each habitat class (`n_vent_only` … `n_nonvent_only`)
* `frac_vent_or_shared` (Figure 4A): the share of its KOs that are vent-only, vent-skewed or
  shared. Lineages with < 15 KOs are flagged in `below_15_KOs`.
* `share_of_vent_only_expr`: its share of all vent-only KO expression (summed TPM in vent
  samples, Figure 4B). `share_of_nonvent_only_expr` is the same for non-vent-only KOs at
  non-vent sites (Figure 4C).
* `lineage_habitat` ("shared" = detected in ≥ 3 samples in each habitat) and the
  taxon-level Cliff's δ on mean share, from 05

```{r s6a}
pairs <- read_out("05b_taxon_ko_habitat")

# expression shares: sum each lineage's pair TPM within a pair class, divided by the class total
expr_share <- function(cls, tpm_col) {
  pairs |>
    filter(habitat_class == cls) |>
    summarise(tpm = sum({{ tpm_col }}), .by = cur_L4) |>
    mutate(share = tpm / sum(tpm)) |>
    select(cur_L4, share)
}

s6a <- read_out("05b_lineage_repertoire") |>
  left_join(expr_share("vent_only", tpm_vent) |> rename(share_of_vent_only_expr = share),
            by = "cur_L4") |>
  left_join(expr_share("nonvent_only", tpm_nonvent) |> rename(share_of_nonvent_only_expr = share),
            by = "cur_L4") |>
  left_join(read_out("05_composition_taxon") |>
              select(cur_L4, taxon_cliffs_delta = cliffs_delta, taxon_delta_significant = significant),
            by = "cur_L4") |>
  transmute(group = cur_group, lineage = taxon, lineage_habitat = taxon_habitat,
            n_KOs = n_ko, n_vent_only = vent_only, n_vent_skewed = vent_skewed, n_shared = shared,
            n_nonvent_skewed = nonvent_skewed, n_nonvent_only = nonvent_only,
            frac_vent_or_shared = frac_vent_only + frac_vent_skewed + frac_shared,
            below_15_KOs = n_ko < 15,
            share_of_vent_only_expr = replace_na(share_of_vent_only_expr, 0),
            share_of_nonvent_only_expr = replace_na(share_of_nonvent_only_expr, 0),
            mean_share_vent, mean_share_nonvent, taxon_cliffs_delta, taxon_delta_significant) |>
  arrange(desc(share_of_vent_only_expr))
s6a
```

**S6b.** Who carries the habitat-only KOs: vent-only and non-vent-only lineage-resolved KOs,
split by the lineage's own habitat class. `frac_KOs` is the share of lineage-resolved KOs
and `share_expr` the share of expression. These are the 94% and 95.6% values in Results E.

```{r s6b}
s6b <- read_out("05b_carrier_summary") |>
  transmute(panel, lineage_habitat = taxon_habitat, n_KOs = n_ko, frac_KOs = frac_ko,
            share_expr = share, n_lineages = n_taxa)
s6b
```

# Table S7: robustness of the vent-only result (script 08)

This table goes with Supplementary Text S1.

* **S7a.** For each depth scheme (`none` = no subsampling; `nonvent_to_vent` = non-vent
  samples subsampled to vent depths; `common_vent_median`; `common_min` = every sample cut to
  the shallowest) and each occupancy rule: the number of vent-only lineage-resolved KOs, how
  many of the 103 from 05b are kept, and the share carried by lineages present in both
  habitats. Values are medians with 95% ranges over 100 draws.
* **S7b.** The same, leaving out one vent field at a time (no subsampling).
* **S7c.** Median sequencing depth and number of KOs detected per sample under each scheme.

```{r s7}
s7a <- read_out("08_lineage_headline_sweep") |>
  transmute(depth_scheme = scheme, occupancy_rule = rule,
            n_vent_only = n_vent_only_med, n_vent_only_lo, n_vent_only_hi,
            n_kept_of_103 = n_kept_from_05b_med, n_kept_lo = n_kept_from_05b_lo,
            n_kept_hi = n_kept_from_05b_hi,
            frac_on_lineages_in_both = frac_on_shared_lineages_med,
            frac_lo = frac_on_shared_lineages_lo, frac_hi = frac_on_shared_lineages_hi)
s7b <- read_out("08_field_drop_lineage") |>
  transmute(field_left_out = dropped, n_vent_samples = n_vent_units, occupancy_rule = rule,
            n_vent_only, n_kept_of_103 = n_kept_from_05b,
            frac_on_lineages_in_both = frac_on_shared_lineages,
            expr_on_lineages_in_both = expr_on_shared_lineages)
s7c <- read_out("08_depth_matched_depths") |>
  rename(depth_scheme = scheme, habitat = vent_bin)
s7a
```

# Table S8: trophic-mode panel, one row per feature (scripts 06, 07)

This is the Table S_panel. Results F and Figure S7 come from here, and these values can be
read off it directly instead of citing separate tables:

* **Mode counts** (261 heterotrophy, 57 symbiosis, ...): count rows by `mode`. A feature
  with two modes (for example "Heterotrophy/phagotrophy | Symbiosis") counts in both.
* **Habitat classes** (97 shared, 115 non-vent-associated, SecY vent-skewed): count by
  `habitat_class`.
* **Subcategory counts** (digestive hydrolases, 42 of 56 shared): count by `subcategory`.
* **Breadth** (tubulin in 28 lineages): `n_lineages_present`, the number of lineages where
  the feature is called present across all samples, as in Figure 5.
* **Cliff's δ** (Figure S7): `cliffs_delta_vent`, reported only for KOs in the ranked
  vent-associated set (`in_ranked_set`). It is descriptive: 07 applies no permutation threshold.

```{r s8}
s8 <- read_out("06_panel_habitat") |>
  left_join(read_out("06_panel_feature_taxon_breadth") |>
              select(feature_id, n_lineages_present = n_taxa_all,
                     n_lineages_detected_any = n_taxa_any_det, n_groups_present = n_groups_all),
            by = "feature_id") |>
  left_join(read_out("07_panel_ko_delta") |>
              select(feature_id, delta_vent, in_ranked_universe),
            by = "feature_id") |>
  transmute(feature_id, match_type, gene = gene_disp, mode = category,
            primary_mode = primary_category, subcategory,
            habitat_class, n_vent_samples_detected = n_det_vent,
            n_nonvent_samples_detected = n_det_nonvent,
            n_lineages_present, n_lineages_detected_any, n_groups_present,
            in_ranked_set = replace_na(in_ranked_universe, FALSE),
            # delta only where the KO is in the ranked universe (see 07: outside it, delta > 0
            # can be an rCLR zero artefact)
            cliffs_delta_vent = if_else(in_ranked_set, delta_vent, NA_real_)) |>
  arrange(primary_mode, subcategory, gene)
s8
```

# Table S9: trophic-mode panel by lineage (script 06)

* **S9a.** For each lineage and mode, the number of panel features present only at non-vent
  sites, in both habitats, or only at vents (Figure 5; Results F lineage counts).
* **S9b.** The vent-only lineage × feature pairs (10 pairs; CTS-CP and CTSB share K01363, so
  they appear as two rows) and whether each is visible in the main or supplementary Figure 5.
* **S9c.** Per sample: the number of panel features detected and their share of all KOs
  detected in that sample (the 11.4% vs. 6.1% in Results F).

```{r s9}
s9a <- read_out("06_panel_taxon_mode_summary") |>
  transmute(group = cur_group, lineage = taxon, mode = category,
            n_nonvent_only = nonvent_only, n_both = both, n_vent_only = vent_only,
            n_features = n_features) |>
  arrange(mode, desc(n_features))

s9b <- read_out("06_panel_taxon_presence") |>
  filter(presence == "vent_only") |>
  transmute(group = cur_group, lineage = taxon, feature_id, gene, mode = category, subcategory,
            n_vent_samples_detected = n_det_vent)

s9c <- read_out("06_panel_unit_summary") |>
  transmute(sample = unit, habitat = vent_bin, field, mode = category,
            n_panel_features_detected = n_panel_detected, n_KOs_detected = n_ko_detected,
            panel_share_of_detected_KOs = frac_of_detected_kos)
s9b
```

# Data S1: all habitat-associated lineage-resolved KOs (script 05b)

This is too long for a numbered table: it has one row per lineage × KO, with habitat class,
detection counts and TPM. It is written as a plain CSV.

```{r data-s1}
data_s1 <- pairs |>
  transmute(group = cur_group, lineage = taxon, ko_id,
            lineage_resolved_class = habitat_class, community_ko_class = ko_habitat,
            lineage_habitat = taxon_habitat, n_vent_samples_detected = n_det_vent,
            n_nonvent_samples_detected = n_det_nonvent, occ_vent, occ_nonvent,
            mean_share_vent, mean_share_nonvent, tpm_vent, tpm_nonvent)
```

# Write

A `README` sheet lists every sheet with a one-line description and its source tables, so
the workbook explains itself without this script.

```{r write}
sheets <- list(S3a = s3a, S3b = s3b, S4 = s4, S5 = s5, S5_ko_classes = s5_ko_classes,
               S6a = s6a, S6b = s6b, S7a = s7a, S7b = s7b, S7c = s7c,
               S8 = s8, S9a = s9a, S9b = s9b, S9c = s9c)

readme <- tribble(
  ~sheet, ~description, ~source,
  "S3a", "PERMANOVA R2 and resolved share of expression per taxonomic rank", "02_grain_curve; 02_resolution_by_depth",
  "S3b", "Mean share of expression per group and class lineage, vent vs. non-vent", "03_taxa_vent_vs_nonvent_group; 03_taxa_vent_vs_nonvent_L4",
  "S4", "Community-level tests: PERMANOVA, PERMDISP, Delta R2, Procrustes, envfit, dbRDA", "04_* (see source_table column)",
  "S5", "KEGG level-B categories: Cliff's delta, mean share, Fisher enrichment by KO class", "05_composition_kegg; 05_kegg_by_habitat; 05_class_kegg_enrichment",
  "S5_ko_classes", "Number of KOs per habitat class (Figure 3B)", "05_ko_habitat_class",
  "S6a", "Lineages: KOs per habitat class, vent-only and non-vent-only expression shares, taxon delta", "05b_lineage_repertoire; 05b_taxon_ko_habitat; 05_composition_taxon",
  "S6b", "Carriers of vent-only and non-vent-only lineage-resolved KOs", "05b_carrier_summary",
  "S7a", "Vent-only lineage-resolved KOs across depth schemes and occupancy rules", "08_lineage_headline_sweep",
  "S7b", "Vent-only lineage-resolved KOs leaving out one vent field", "08_field_drop_lineage",
  "S7c", "Median sequencing depth and KOs detected per depth scheme", "08_depth_matched_depths",
  "S8", "Trophic-mode panel: one row per feature, habitat class, breadth, Cliff's delta", "06_panel_habitat; 06_panel_feature_taxon_breadth; 07_panel_ko_delta",
  "S9a", "Panel features per lineage and mode by where present", "06_panel_taxon_mode_summary",
  "S9b", "Vent-only lineage x feature pairs", "06_panel_taxon_presence",
  "S9c", "Panel features per sample and share of detected KOs", "06_panel_unit_summary"
) |>
  # one date for the workbook: the newest input table, so a reader can see how current it is
  mutate(newest_input_written = max(input_dates$written))
stopifnot(setequal(readme$sheet, names(sheets)))   # README covers every sheet, no extras

writexl::write_xlsx(c(list(README = readme), sheets),
                    file.path(OUT_DIR, "Supplementary_Tables_S3-S9.xlsx"))
iwalk(sheets, \(df, nm) write_csv(df, file.path(OUT_DIR, glue("Table_{nm}.csv"))))
write_csv(data_s1, file.path(OUT_DIR, "Data_S1_lineage_resolved_KOs.csv"))
message(glue("Wrote {length(sheets)} sheets + README to {OUT_DIR}/Supplementary_Tables_S3-S9.xlsx"))
```

# QC

These checks reproduce the values the Results text cites from each table. If one fails, an
upstream table has changed, and the text needs re-checking against it.

```{r qc}
near2 <- \(x, y, tol = 0.002) isTRUE(abs(x - y) < tol)
stopifnot(
  # S3: rank 4 resolves 82% of expression; 231 taxa after the prevalence filter
  near2(s3a$resolved_share_tpm[s3a$rank == 4][1], 0.82, 0.01),
  any(s3a$n_taxa == 231 & s3a$rank == 4),
  # S4: habitat PERMANOVA R2 = 0.124 (taxonomy) and 0.120 (function)
  near2(s4$value[s4$test == "PERMANOVA" & s4$matrix == "taxonomy" & s4$factor == "Vent vs. non-vent"], 0.124),
  near2(s4$value[s4$test == "PERMANOVA" & s4$matrix == "function" & s4$factor == "Vent vs. non-vent"], 0.120),
  # S5: translation is the only significant category (delta = 0.85)
  sum(s5$significant) == 1, s5$kegg_level_B[s5$significant] == "Translation",
  # S5 footnote: 31 vent-only and 814 shared KOs
  s5_ko_classes$n_KOs[s5_ko_classes$habitat_class == "vent_only"] == 31,
  s5_ko_classes$n_KOs[s5_ko_classes$habitat_class == "shared"] == 814,
  # S6: 59 lineages with >= 15 KOs; vent-only expression shares sum to 1
  sum(!s6a$below_15_KOs) == 59,
  near2(sum(s6a$share_of_vent_only_expr), 1, 1e-6),
  near2(sum(s6a$share_of_nonvent_only_expr), 1, 1e-6),
  # S6b: 97 of 103 vent-only lineage-resolved KOs on lineages present in both habitats
  s6b$n_KOs[str_detect(s6b$panel, "^Vent-only") & s6b$lineage_habitat == "shared"] == 97,
  # S8: one row per feature (320), 97 shared heterotrophy features, SecY vent-skewed
  nrow(s8) == 320, !anyDuplicated(s8$feature_id),
  sum(s8$primary_mode == "Heterotrophy/phagotrophy" & s8$habitat_class == "shared") == 97,
  s8$habitat_class[s8$feature_id == "K03076"] == "vent_skewed",
  sum(s8$in_ranked_set) == 110,
  # S9b: 10 distinct vent-only lineage x feature pairs
  nrow(distinct(s9b, lineage, feature_id)) == 10
)
```
